_comment: Packages for the Honk profile. All of them are installed from the package mirror;
the Honk entry is mirror-only because the wrapper is only usable together with the
release assets the mirror re-hosts (read by fetch-honk-source.py).

packages.name: honk
packages.note: 镜像按上游 release 同步 wrapper、generated-stage.mk 与全部哈希锁定资源；构建前由 .github/scripts/fetch-honk-source.py 校验并下载到 dl/，不再访问 kenzok8/openwrt-honk。

packages.name: luci-app-lucky
packages.note: LuCI 界面跟随上游（已是 3.0.0）；lucky 核心从 3.x 起闭源，只在 https://release.66666.host/ 发布，GitHub 停在 v2.27.2。镜像用 overrides/luci-app-lucky/lucky/Makefile 固定核心包，构建前由 .github/scripts/pin-lucky-source.py 对齐官方最新发布与逐架构 sha256。
